The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with varying degrees of support from different targets. The evidence is consistent across multiple pathways, highlighting a potential mechanism where Corticatic Acid E may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the downstream targets, ultimately affecting RWLeu4. The exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct relationship between Corticatic Acid E and RWLeu4.
